buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 50% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 50 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 50 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 50 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Provisions for workmen compensation, insurance, public liability, property damage, insurance etc. to be ensured by the contractor. Also, safety measures prescribed for working in Extra High Voltage & use of personnel protective equipment must be adhered to. 3. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses SCOPE OF WORK for hiring of telescopic Hydraulic crane, Cap 35 ΤΟΝ 1 The hydraulic crane shall be of minimum 35 tones capacity with adjustable bo om length of minimum 22 meter 2. The vendor shall provide crane with valid testing report of crane under clause A (III) sub section (1) of section 28/29 of Rule 55 A of the Factories Act at time o f execution of job. 3. Vendor shall provide the crane with valid Registration certificate from any Ind ian State transport Authority at time of execution of job. 4. Crane shall be utilized on as and when required basis either day or night inclu ding Sundays and holidays. No mobilization/demonization charge shall be paid extra. Requirement of cranes for 360 hours mentioned in BOQ may scatter over a period of 45-50 days as it is associated with the Major Inspection work of GT# 1, however validity of the contract shall remain valid for one year. Actual usage may also vary and limited to BOQ qty. There is no guarantee of the number of d ays crane services will be utilized. Payment shall be strictly based on actual usa ge.

5. Tools and tackle required for execution of work (like wooden Slipper, ceiling r ope) etc. are in the scope of contractor. Ceiling rope shall be of minimum 35 To n capacity with valid load test certificate. 6. All the required labor & supervision are in scope of contractor. 7. Crane is required for Lifting heavy jobs especially Turbine rotor etc with preci sion in Plant area. Crane operator should have valid license to operate crane an d shall be in healthy state at the time of arrival at site. 8. Vendor should provide valid load test certificate of crane and ceiling rope at time of execution of job 9. Crane shall be utilized as and when required basis 10. The contactor may be asked to provide two cranes if required and payment shall do accordingly and on same terms & conditions and rate. Same document s shall be required for the second crane also. 11 Payment will be released as per actual usage of crane 12. If any part of the fixture/part of the buildings/structure during execution on during work hours plus over time & due to negligence of the Contractor or the la borers engaged by him gets damaged, shall be replaced / rectified at the Contr actor's cost. 13. Crane Operator, Diesel charges, oil/consumables & Transportation of Crane from Contractor Site to Gas turbine power station, IPGCL, Near IP Metro station, New Delhi-110002 and applicable permit etc are included in the per hours/day c harges. IPGCL will not bear any charges apart from the Hiring charges mentione d in the BOQ and shall not pay any Extra Charges for To & Fro Movement of Cra ne. 14. Daily time log sheets shall be sign between crane operator and IPGCL officia ls for billing purposes. Special T&C 1. The firm should be in the business of operating/providing crane of similar cap acity or above for a minimum of 03 years (to be supported by necessary docum ents and submitted along with technical bid). 2. Statutory Deduction-Income tax and other statutory deduction shall be deduc ted from the vendor‘s invoice as per rule. 3. One day crane is considered 8 hours shift in a day per crane. Any additional hours are chargeable extra on pro rata basis. 4. Mobilization-Vendor shall mobilize to site within 24 hours of intimation throug h fax/telephone/ Email. Once crane is called at site it shall be utilize for minimu m of 8 hrs and additional hours are chargeable extra on pro rata basis. 5. Service provider shall abide at all times by the all existing labor enactments and rules made there under, regulations, notifications and bye laws of the State

or Central Government or local authority and any other labor law (including rule s), regulations, bye laws that may be passed or notification that may be issued under any labor law in future either by the State or the Central Government or t he local authority. 6. The service provider shall be responsible for ensuring compliance with the pr ovisions related to Labor Law [Central/State] and specially Workmen Compensa tion Act, EPF Laws, ESIC Laws, Income tax laws and Minimum Wages Laws, Cont ract Labor (Regulations Abolition Act) and any other relevant acts as applicable at present or in future during the tenure of the contract and as may be enforced from time to time. The responsibility for compliance of all the applicable Laws/A cts/Rules shall rest with the service provider only and the buyer will not be liable in any manner. The vendor shall maintain all the aforementioned docume nts, which are not required to be submitted along with the invoice. However, th ese documents may be verified by IPGCL or any regulatory authority representa tive during inspection/audit. The vendor shall be held responsible in case of non -compliance with applicable rules. 7. Service Provider shall cover its personnel (crane operator /helper) for person al accident and death whilst performing the duty and the IPGCL shall own no lia bility and obligation in this regard. Vendor shall submit the copy of insurance be fore the start of work. 8. Service provider shall employ only manpower who has completed eighteen y ears of age and not above 60 years of age. 9. The Service Provider shall not deploy or shall discontinue deploying the perso n(s), if desired by the Buyer and must ensure prompt replacement of the person nel without any additional cost to the Buyer. 10. The operators of the equipment’s should possess valid training and compete ncy test certificate for operation of the equipment or category of the equipment (s) from recognized certifying agencies. The copy of the above documents is to be submitted to the consignee before commencement of the job. 11. Operators / helper shall be provided with safety gears like hard hat, safety s hoes etc. and will follow site safety regulations. 12. Vendor shall provide one operator and at least one Helper for crane operati on. 13. Contract Period shall be valid for a period of One year from the date of start of the work. 14. Vendor shall provide fuel (Diesel) for cranes. 15. Crane operator shall follow site engineer instructions. 16. During crane working hours work period held due to any problem in crane s hall not be payable to the vendor. 17. Vendor should provide valid load test certificate for crane & Ceiling rope at t ime of execution of job. 18. Crane operator should have valid license to operate crane and shall submit at time of execution of job. 19. Work to be carried out at GTPS as per site requirement. As mentioned in Sc ope of work and Special T&C "Crane shall be utilized on as and when required b

asis" and Payment shall be released as per actual work done only. Vendor shall mobilize to site within 24 hours of intimation through fax/telephone/ Email. PO s hall be valid for 1 year from start of the work. 20. INSTRUCTIONS REGARDING COMMON IP ADDRESS: Bidders are advised to note that if any bid is found to have a matching or comm on IP address with any other bidder on the GeM Portal, all such bids shall be out rightly rejected without any further communication and will not be considered fo r further evaluation. 21. BOQ for price: The seller/Bidder are advised that BOQ should not be attached with the techno- Commercial bid documents otherwise bid will be out rightly rejected as it is two part bidding case. .
